owner.description: GitHub repository owner (user or organization login), e.g. "tale-project".

projectId.description: Tale project ID whose board the review task lives on. Copy from the project URL.

steps.name: Link PR To A Review Task

parameters.title: {{'Review pull request ' + input.owner + '/' + input.repo + '#' + input.pull_number}}
parameters.description: {{'Review GitHub pull request ' + input.owner + '/' + input.repo + '#' + input.pull_number + '. Read the diff and changed files, then post a review.'}}

parameters.instructions: Review the GitHub pull request named in the task. Use the GitHub integration to call get_pull_request_diff and get_pull_request_files for the diff and changed files, assess correctness, risk, and style, then post your verdict with create_pull_request_review using event REQUEST_CHANGES (if issues), APPROVE (if clean), or COMMENT (if only notes). Add inline comments for specific lines where useful. Do NOT merge. Summarize your review as a task comment and finish the task at in_review.
parameters.promptContext: {{'GitHub pull request to review: ' + input.owner + '/' + input.repo + '#' + input.pull_number}}
